It is composed of two thicker vertical end posts, each capped at top and bottom with beveled square caps; two long horizontal rectangular rails running between the posts; and seven vertical square-profile balusters or bars evenly spaced between the rails. Each of the seven inner bars features a small cube-shaped faceted decorative collar around its center. The object is rendered in a hand-painted/stylized 3D game asset aesthetic, textured to look like aged, dark brown-grey hammered iron or steel with prominent orange-brown rust mottling and lighter edge highlights. The entire object is fully visible within the frame and is uncropped. The background is a solid, completely uniform bright blue with no shadows, ground plane, or scenery.
